name: know-fu
description: Ingest books, videos and specialized research into a connected local library for teaching, application and grounded ideas.

interface.longDescription: A local research corpus with immutable originals, explanatory records, qualified graph relationships, semantic retrieval and a maintained wiki. Codex supplies reasoning; setup selects storage and service options.
defaultPrompt: Ingest this source into my research library.
Teach me this topic using my research library.
What important question should we investigate next?
